title: Cancer-type-specific sets (topic-appropriate reviewers)
context: General QPL sets (M0/M1/M2) cover questions relevant to most cancer patients. M3 adds cancer-type-specific sets (e.g., breast, lung, colorectal, sarcoma) that include questions specific to that cancer's staging, treatment landscape, and patient concerns. These require topic-appropriate credentialed reviewers: a lung oncologist for a lung-cancer set, a surgical oncologist for a colorectal set, etc. A general oncologist is insufficient for type-specific clinical accuracy. Sets are scoped by the partner's stated priorities and the available reviewer coverage; no type-specific set is published without the appropriate reviewer.
objective: Author at least one cancer-type-specific QPL set (e.g., breast cancer — newly-diagnosed, or lung cancer — treatment-decision) with a topic-appropriate credentialed reviewer (specialty oncologist for that cancer type) plus a patient advocate, passing the full pipeline: allow-listed sources, provenance, style guide, dual sign-off, automated CI gates, disclaimer, support resources.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one cancer-type-specific QPL set is present in sets/<stage>/<cancer-type>/set.yaml, validating against qplSetSchema; the appliesTo field lists the specific cancer type (not 'general')

The set has a topic-appropriate specialty clinician reviewer (not just a general oncologist): credentials must be relevant to the specific cancer type; credentials verified and recorded in the review block
The set is original (original-authorship attestation present), grounded in allow-listed sources with provenance on all claims, containing the verbatim disclaimer and verified support resources
All UNCERTAIN: flags resolved before sign-off; dual expert sign-off (specialty clinician + patient advocate, each with COI declaration) recorded in review block and PR
All automated CI gates pass: schema validation, license/provenance enforcement, readability/accessibility checks
The type-specific set does not duplicate questions already in the general set for the same stage; it adds questions specific to the cancer type's staging, treatment options, or patient concerns
Coverage matrix is updated to reflect the new type-specific cell
resources: docs/partner-brief.md (qpl-partner-001 — partner priorities may specify cancer type)
NCI / Cancer.gov / PDQ cancer-type-specific patient pages (public domain; allow-listed)
output: sets/<stage>/<cancer-type>/set.yaml with dual expert sign-off block; updated coverage matrix
